verify.subject: Confirm your email for Korpora

alreadyRegistered.subject: You already have a Korpora account

reset.subject: New password for Korpora

invite.subject: An account has been created for you in Korpora

passwordChanged.subject: Your Korpora password was changed
passwordChanged.body:
The password of your account was just changed and all other sessions were signed out.

If it was not you, set a new password right away: {reset}

codeFailures.subject: Wrong sign-in codes on Korpora
codeFailures.body:
Someone entered your correct password but not the right code from the authenticator app. After several failed attempts, signing in to your account is paused for {minutes}.

If this was not you, someone else knows your password. Change it now: {reset}

reauthFailures.subject: Failed confirmations in your Korpora account
reauthFailures.body:
In an open session of your account, a wrong password or code was entered several times in a row to confirm an action (changing the password or email, two-factor protection, deleting the account). All sessions have therefore been ended, and signing in is paused for {minutes}.

If this was not you, someone had access to one of your open sessions. Set a new password right away: {reset}

newDevice.subject: Sign-in from a new device on Korpora

twoFactorOn.subject: Two-factor protection is on
twoFactorOn.body:
Two-factor protection is now on for your Korpora account. Keep your recovery codes somewhere safe.

If it was not you, change your password right away: {security}

twoFactorOff.subject: Two-factor protection is off
twoFactorOff.body:
Two-factor protection is now off for your Korpora account.

If it was not you, change your password and turn it back on: {security}

changeEmail.subject: Confirm your new email for Korpora

emailChangeNotice.subject: A change of your Korpora email was requested
emailChangeNotice.body:
A change of your account's email to {email} was requested. The email changes only when the new address is confirmed.

If it was not you, change your password right away: {security}

emailChangedByStaff.subject: Your Korpora email was changed
emailChangedByStaff.body:
The Korpora team changed your account's email to {email}. From now on you sign in with the new address, and links sent to this address no longer work.

If you did not ask for this, write to us right away at the address below.

trialEnding.subject: Your Korpora trial ends on {date}
trialEnding.body:
Your trial ends on {date}. After that your projects stay and can be downloaded, but new projects and changes need a plan.

Plans and prices: {plan}

planChanged.subject: Your Korpora plan has changed

accountDeleted.subject: Your Korpora account was deleted
accountDeleted.body:
Your account and all its projects have been deleted permanently. They remain in the database backups only until those expire — the periods are in the privacy policy.{orders}

If you did not ask for this, write to us at the address below.
accountDeleted.orders: We keep your orders with the contract details only — name, email, amount, dates, the terms you accepted, early start and withdrawal — and delete them {kept} after the account is deleted.

banned.subject: Your access to Korpora has been blocked

order.subject: Confirmation of your Korpora order
order.priceBusiness: {net} excl. VAT; VAT is charged under the rules of your country and shown on the invoice
order.paymentEarly: Payment: by bank transfer, using the invoice with the payment details that we will send you. You asked for the plan to start right after payment, before the {days}-day withdrawal period ends. If you withdraw, you will pay for the time the plan was active.
order.paymentWait: Payment: by bank transfer, using the invoice with the payment details that we will send you. You did not ask for an early start, so the paid period will start after the withdrawal period ends ({date}).
order.paymentBusiness: Payment: by bank transfer, using the invoice with the payment details that we will send you. The plan is activated once the payment arrives.
order.withdrawalConsumer:
Right of withdrawal: you may withdraw from the contract until {date} inclusive, without giving any reason — with the “Withdraw from contract here” button under “Plan” in your account, or with an unequivocal statement to {contact}, for example using the model form below. If you withdraw, we will refund all payments we received from you no later than {refundDays} days after we receive your withdrawal, using the same means of payment and at no cost to you. If you asked for an early start, we keep the part of the price for the time the plan was active.

{form}
order.withdrawalBusiness: You are buying as a business or self-employed person for professional purposes, so the consumer right of withdrawal does not apply.
order.durationTerm: Term: {term}; Premium does not renew by itself — it ends at the end of the term.
order.durationLifetime: Term: Lifetime is valid for as long as Korpora is offered.
order.replaces: This order replaces order no. {ids}, which has been cancelled. If you have already paid for it, write to us at {contact}.
order.consumerRights: As a consumer you also have the legal guarantee of conformity for digital services. Complaints go to {contact}; for out-of-court settlement you can turn to the Bulgarian Commission for Consumer Protection (www.kzp.bg).
order.termsAttached: The terms you accepted with the order (in force from {date}) are attached to this email as a file; online: {link}
order.termsLink: The terms you accepted with the order (in force from {date}): {link}

mail.withdrawalForm:
Model withdrawal form
(complete and return this form only if you wish to withdraw from the contract)
— To {to}:
— I/We (*) hereby give notice that I/We (*) withdraw from my/our (*) contract of sale of the following goods (*)/for the provision of the following service (*),
— Ordered on (*)/received on (*),
— Name of consumer(s),
— Address of consumer(s),
— Signature of consumer(s) (only if this form is notified on paper),
— Date
(*) Delete as appropriate.

withdrawn.subject: We have received your withdrawal from the Korpora contract
withdrawn.statement: I hereby give notice that I withdraw from my contract for the provision of the following service: Korpora — {plan}, order no. {id} of {date}, name of consumer: {name}, confirmation to {email}.

plan.reverted: Your plan has been returned to what it was before the order.
plan.manual: We will end the plan you received with this order.

withdrawn.refund: If you have already paid, we will refund all payments we received from you no later than {date}, using the same means of payment and at no cost to you.
withdrawn.refundEarly: If you have already paid, we will refund the payments we received from you no later than {date}, using the same means of payment and at no cost to you. As you asked for an early start, we keep the part of the price for the time the plan was active.

orderRejected.subject: Your Korpora order has been rejected
orderRejected.body:
Order no. {id} ({plan}) of {date} has been rejected and will not be fulfilled — you do not need to pay it. If you have already paid or think this is a mistake, write to us at {contact}.

Your orders: {orders}

staffOrder.subject: New Korpora order: {plan}
staffOrder.activationNow: Can be activated once the payment arrives.
staffOrder.activationAfter: Activate no earlier than {date} — a consumer without an early-start request.
staffOrder.replaces: Replaces order no. {ids} (cancelled) — check whether a payment has arrived for it.

staffWithdrawal.subject: Withdrawal from a Korpora contract: {email}

plan.open: The order had not been activated.
plan.reverted: The plan was returned automatically to its state before the order.
plan.manual: The plan was NOT returned automatically (it was changed later) — fix it by hand.

staffWithdrawal.early: The customer asked for an early start: keep the part for the time the plan was active.
staffWithdrawal.full: No early start: refund the full amount.

staffAccountDeleted.subject: Deleted account with an order awaiting payment: {email}

planEnding.subject: Your Korpora Premium plan ends on {date}
planEnding.body:
Your Premium plan ends on {date} — it does not renew by itself. After that your projects stay and can be downloaded, but new projects and changes need an active plan.

To continue, order a new term: {plan}
